purpose: Require the physical grass-blade layer to exist in the persisted benchmark scene before formal rendering, rather than relying on an unsaved scene-open mutation that could render pixels not represented by the persisted scene evidence state.

scope: grass hierarchy local transforms and active state
MeshFilter asset path, dependency hash, mesh name, vertex/submesh count and bounds
Renderer enabled state, shadow/probe policy, material asset path/dependency hash and live PBR scalar/color/texture bindings
LODGroup fade policy, transitions and renderer assignments
fingerprint.reason: Temporary benchmark-camera transforms may dirty the broader scene during capture, so the guard binds only the grass render state to the most recently saved canonical-scene baseline instead of requiring the entire scene to remain globally clean.

rejectIf: formal render begins without a saved grass fingerprint baseline
GrassBladeFieldDetail or generator marker is missing
current grass render fingerprint differs from the latest scene-saved fingerprint
grass source QA fails before a formal camera cull
the source contract or canonical source material is unavailable when the benchmark scene is opened

failureInjection: open the canonical scene and delete one grass patch without saving, then invoke a formal camera
change one grass LOD transition without saving, then invoke a formal camera
swap one patch mesh or material after the latest scene save
remove the saved fingerprint baseline and invoke QualityCamera
remove GrassBladeFieldDetail before the canonical scene-open persistence pass

requiredEvidence: fresh grazing 3840x2160 plus lawn silhouette crop

expectedVisualFidelityImpact.vegetationNaturalComplexity: Preserves the implemented blade geometry in the exact saved scene used for evidence; no points until pixels are reviewed.
expectedVisualFidelityImpact.temporalLodAliasingStability: Prevents formal temporal evidence from silently using an unsaved or later-mutated grass LOD state; no points until temporal pixels are reviewed.
expectedVisualFidelityImpact.criticalDefectEvidence: Reduces provenance ambiguity around visible primitive fallback, repetition, floating vegetation and LOD-pop review without auto-clearing any defect.
